:::{#thm-ds-lik-obs-lik}
#### Dataset likelihood as a product of observation likelihoods

For mutually independent data $\vx \eqdef \x1n$,
the likelihood of the dataset is the product
of the observations' [likelihood components](#def-lik-factor):

$$\Lik(\theta) = \prodin \Lik_i(\theta)$$
:::

::: proof
By @thm-lik-iid, $\Lik(\theta) = \prod_{i=1}^n \p(X_i = x_i \mid \theta)$,
and by @def-lik-factor, each factor $\p(X_i = x_i \mid \theta)$ is $\Lik_i(\theta)$.
:::
